keyPhrases.text: rich with insights into the human condition
rich and compelling direction of Sam Mendes
brings Butterworth's writing and characters to life
not a weak link among them
portrayed with youthful zeal and commitment
dysfunctional Irish archetypes (or are they stereotypes?)

reasoning: Strong positive review with extensive praise for direction ('rich and compelling'), cast ('stellar ensemble,' 'not a weak link'), and writing ('rich with insights,' 'exquisite passages'). While noting disturbing content and questioning stereotypes, these appear to be analytical observations rather than criticisms of quality. The review demonstrates deep appreciation for the craft and artistry.
